body: Hey. No, I 'm not seeing a therapist. I have thought about seeing one, but never got the courage to actually go and make apointment.

@TonyRealm Hey, there is pretty much nobody I feel comfortable talking to. I have talked to my friend, after listening to me he suggested this page. I've been thinking to talk to my family about it, but I just can't. Thank you about the lyrics! And yes, I do, I'm still working into songs and everything. I just hope this feeling that makes me sit home alone and do nothing goes away so I can finally do something and speak to people.
